For international buyers

Tell us what you need.

Buyers can request Indian products or source from suppliers in other countries. Styflys can coordinate the connection instead of leaving the buyer to search blindly.

Buyer Requirement

  • Product / category
  • Quantity & MOQ
  • Quality / specifications
  • Destination country
  • Target budget
  • Required delivery timeline
  • B2B or B2C requirement

What happens next?

Styflys receives the requirement → identifies suitable suppliers → coordinates communication → quotation → sample/confirmation → order → export tracking.

Goal: a more transparent and organized international buying experience.
